neighbours.label: 'just as easily' / 'just as well' after a modal ('could just as easily have been …')
fire: The speech could just as easily have been written by his aide.
This poem may just as well be read as a prayer.
A short memo can just as easily explain the new policy.
The money could just as easily go to the local school.
That scene might just as well have been cut from the film.
Any student can just as easily learn this at home.
Her result could just as well be due to chance.
A smaller engine would just as easily move this light boat.
quiet: The speech could easily have been written by his aide.
This poem was read aloud as a prayer last year.
A short memo can explain the new policy.
The money had just gone to the local school.
That scene was cut just as the film was released.
Any student can learn this at home.
Her result came in just as we sat down.
A smaller engine would easily move this light boat.
